scope: ordinary identity-mass ODEs; selected DOPRI5 and RODAS5P; application-specific work excluded
assessment: bounded candidate; unrestricted production readiness not established by this numerical audit

proofs.claim: DOPRI5 exact rational tableau satisfies all endpoint order conditions through five and embedded conditions through four
limits: Exact rational interpretation; floating-point and callback perturbations separate.
Embedded local estimate is not a global-error certificate.

proofs.claim: Declared constant-frequency normal skew-Hermitian system has a constructive global DOPRI5 state-error bound under |omega|max*hmax <= 0.9
limits: Exact arithmetic, positive variable steps summing to T.
Not a theorem for general nonlinear or nonnormal oscillators.

proofs.claim: Arbitrary accepted-state method selection preserves order under common uniform stability and defect bounds
limits: Requires eligible method maps with specified Lipschitz/local-defect bounds.
Current selector chooses before integration; automatic switching is not implemented.

proofs.claim: Pause/resume preserves deterministic transition trajectory and work when the full native state and registered schedule are unchanged
proofs.work: DOPRI5 FSAL: 1+6*A RHS calls for A full trials; K restarts give K+6*A only on otherwise identical attempted trajectories
limits: Partial failed callbacks excluded from that exact RHS formula.
Provider or model change invalidates caches.

findings.summary: Reused finite stage storage concealed incomplete Ok callback writes in the implicit facade
findings.behavior: Nonfinite numerical inputs are refused before entering user code; outputs are poisoned; malformed Ok is terminal; sparse Jacobian writes preserved.
limits: Raw native entry points outside the facade do not inherit this guard.
Additional O(n) guard work must be included in timings.

findings.summary: Fast RODAS scalar/vector acceptance norm did not reject overflowed tolerance scale
limits: Contract/controller inconsistency; not claimed to demonstrate an inaccurate step falsely accepted.

findings.summary: Fast RODAS sum of normalized squares can overflow for extreme rejected defects
findings.reason: For realizable dimensions, such a norm already requires rejection; possible overconservative shrinkage requires performance evidence.
